title: A highly effective curcumin analogue as “naked eye” colorimetric and fluorescent sensor for sensitive and selective detection of Hg2+ ions and its application on test strips and real sample analysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,25811-25822
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03656A, Paper
Open Access

Ramesh D. K., Prasad Pralhad Pujar
An efficient colorimetric and fluorometric sensor TAA was successfully synthesized, and characterized. Its photophysical properties and sensing behavior were investigated and the binding mechanism was demonstrated for Hg2+ ions.
